question: Which chapter concerning the half-Hari image concludes with this colophon statement?
premises: The verse marks a textual conclusion.
It names the chapter on the characteristics of the half-Hari image.
It gives the chapter’s ordinal position as seventy-sixth.
inference: This is the colophon of the seventy-sixth chapter on the characteristics of the half-Hari image.
plain_english: Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter, on the characteristics of the half-Hari image, in the Aṃśumān of Kāśyapa.
